items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: George Kleinsinger, the composer, is here in this hotel

ctx.x: Jones Beach. And they have an indoor pool down in Belmore that I do a little swimming there a couple of times a week. Try to keep in shape a little.
George Kleinsinger, the composer, is here in this hotel and he goes across the street to the YMCA to swim every single day of his life.
